title: SuperLocalMemory 4.0: The Governed Memory Operating System for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.08253v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present SuperLocalMemory 4.0, a governed, local-first memory operating system for AI agents, unifying multi-channel retrieval under reciprocal-rank fusion, bi-temporal recall, multi-scope isolation, role-based access, verified erasure, and a hash-chained audit trail. A reliability spine governs the primary write path: generation-fenced admission, verifiable memory transactions with per-projection apply, verify, compensate and erase owners, and hash-checkable completion manifests. Eleven fault-injection scenarios, each repeated 200 times, upheld 2,199 of 2,200 scoped component properties. This version leads with a negative result. Ten mechanisms here were implemented, reachable on a live call path, and ineffective at their final connection. translated_title: SuperLocalMemory 4.0：面向AI代理的受治理内存操作系统
translated_abstract: 我们提出了SuperLocalMemory 4.0，一个受治理的、本地优先的AI代理内存操作系统，它统一了多通道检索，结合了倒数排名融合、双时态回忆、多范围隔离、基于角色的访问、验证擦除以及哈希链审计追踪。一个可靠性主干管理着主要写入路径：生成围栏准入、可验证的内存事务（每个投影应用、验证、补偿和擦除所有者），以及可哈希检查的完成清单。十一个故障注入场景，每个重复200次，维持了2,200个范围组件属性中的2,199个。此版本以负面结果为首要发现。这里实施的十个机制，在实时调用路径上是可达的，但在最终连接处无效。实施、可达和有效是三个不同的问题，第三个需要一个独立于被测机制的预言机。我们贡献了两个机械不变量来提供这些。
tldr: 本文介绍了SuperLocalMemory 4.0，一种受治理的本地优先AI代理内存操作系统，通过统一多通道检索和可靠性机制，并基于故障注入测试揭示了机制可达性与有效性之间的关键差异，贡献了两个机械不变量。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SuperLocalMemory 4.0, a governed local-first memory OS for AI agents, unifying multi-channel retrieval with reliability mechanisms, and through fault-injection testing reveals the critical gap between reachable and effective mechanisms, contributing two mechanical invariants.
